# Kummer extensions generated by a root of a unit are unramified

Module `Nyll.GaloisCohomology.Kummer.Concrete.LocalUnitKummerUnramified`, copied unchanged from the Lean library NYLL. The origin of the file is given at the end of this page.

The file gives a criterion for a finite extension of nonarchimedean local fields to be unramified when it is generated by an `n`-th root of a unit and `n` is itself a unit. It does not depend on the global Kummer construction.

- `isUnramifiedValuedExtension_of_unit_kummer_generator`: let `F/C` be a finite separable extension of nonarchimedean local fields, with compatible valuations and `𝒪_F` finite over `𝒪_C`. Suppose `b ∈ C` and `β ∈ F` have valuation `1`, `n` has valuation `1` in `C`, `β^n = b`, and `β` generates `F` as a `C`-algebra. Then `F/C` is unramified in the sense of the library's `IsUnramifiedValuedExtension`.

Proof: `β` is a unit of `𝒪_F` and a root of `X^n − b` over `𝒪_C`, whose derivative `n X^(n−1)` takes a unit value at `β`. A criterion from the library's theory of complete discretely valued fields (`isUnramifiedAt_of_aeval_derivative_isUnit`) then shows that `𝒪_F` is unramified at its maximal ideal over `𝒪_C`, so the ramification index is `1`.

Points to watch: unramifiedness is the library's notion (ramification index `1` over the valuation ring of the base), and the statement asks for an `Algebra 𝒪[C] F` instance and finiteness of `𝒪[F]` over `𝒪[C]` as hypotheses.
